settings.title: Settings
settings.panicExplainer: Immediately and permanently erases all drafts, evidence files, and your identity key from this device. On-chain fingerprints cannot be deleted, but nothing links them to this device once local data is gone.
settings.panicConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. All drafts, evidence, and your identity will be destroyed.
settings.transportExplainer: Khabardar never collects your name or phone number, but network traffic can still reveal your IP. On Android, use Orbot in VPN mode to route this app through Tor.
settings.torModeHint: Prefer onion endpoints and treat traffic as Tor-routed when Orbot is active.
settings.orbotActiveHint: Turn this on only after Orbot VPN mode is running and Khabardar is included.
settings.transportProtected: Traffic is currently protected through Tor (Orbot active).
settings.transportUnprotected: Traffic is not currently routed through Tor.
settings.orbotInstallHint: Install Orbot from Google Play or F-Droid, enable VPN mode, and include Khabardar. Then toggle “Orbot is active” above.
